scenes.setting: Transactions wind up: Derrick's Spirit Eater stomach pouch for Fors, the Solar High Priest formula conjured for The Sun, Alger picks three City of Silver ingredients and asks Fors to ready the Dragon-Eyed Sea Condor eyeballs; free exchange -- Fors warns Backlund is still under pressure, The Hanged Man tells The Sun to check on the Chief before any ritual, and The World asks the ladies for a radio transceiver before mentioning the revived custom at Bansy Harbor and its corrupted Storms bishop
scenes.text_anchor: “Miss Magician, your Spirit Eater’s stomach pouch is ready.”

scenes.setting: Deep laughter from the end of the table: Mr. Fool says Bansy 'reminds me of a King of Angels' -- Medici, who established the Rose Redemption, whose descendants live in Binsy, the old name of Bansy; Fors despairs at the scale of it, Emlyn feels like a messiah, and Alger realizes Mr. Fool foresaw last week's promise about meeting the Kings of Angels
scenes.text_anchor: “Medici, who established the Rose Redemption. ‘His’ descendants live in Binsy.”
